name: How can I add more storage to a small laundry room?

mainEntity.name: How can I add more storage to a small laundry room?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can maximize space in a compact laundry room by utilizing vertical storage, installing pocket doors, and adding custom upper cabinetry that extends to the ceiling. Recessed shelving built between wall studs provides storage for detergents without taking up floor room. If space permits, installing a pull-out drying rack or an overhead hanging rod provides functional drying space without cluttering the walking path, allowing you to use every square foot efficiently.
acceptedAnswer.description: Use vertical space with tall cabinetry, add hanging rods, install pocket doors, and incorporate recessed wall shelving between wall studs.
